dedupe_keys.name: optilogic cosmic frog cloud supply chain design platform

description: Cosmic Frog is Optilogic's cloud platform for designing supply chains: users build a digital model of their network from suppliers through plants and warehouses to customers, then optimise and simulate it to trade off cost, service, risk and sustainability. Contents and functions: full-scale network optimisation, transportation strategy (lanes, modes and equipment), asset footprint studies of adding or removing plants and warehouses, tariff and tax scenarios, risk analysis with an automatic risk rating for every scenario, simulation of designs under real-world variability, large sensitivity runs, sustainability views of water, energy and greenhouse gas impacts, an Excel companion and a natural-language assistant (Leapfrog AI). Coverage: any geography the user models. Format and access: a web and cloud service with concurrent solves for large models; a free account can be created and enterprise use is sold. Licence and cost: proprietary; free tier, paid plans. Caveats: vendor claims were not tested, and model data stay with the user, so no public dataset comes with it. It supports optimisation, network flow and resilience studies of freight and logistics networks, for example testing a warehouse or lane outage. It relates to anyLogistix in the catalogue.
